messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for `inference-eu-embeds-prod` — high error rate (5xx). Pager: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-5xx

alex: on it. grabbing bridge and looking at metrics.

maria: acked on PD. i'll start with autoscaler + queue backlog check.

support-bot: affected customers attached: cust-ark (ID 7891), cust-hastings (ID 1122). opening support threads.

alex: quick note — embeddings queue length jumped from ~2k -> ~120k in 60s, many requests hitting fallback path and returning 503.

kevin: i can check DB and redis for blocking. ping me if replication lag shows up.

alex: running `kubectl -n inference get hpa` now. suspect autoscaler didn't pick up burst because pod startup lag.

maria: i pushed a temporary scale target to minReplicas=6 and triggered a manual rollout to force new pods.

alex: good. also routing rule: toggled route to `embeddings-approx-fast` for non-critical customers to shed load.

sre-oncall: @alex @maria please add short mitigation note for postmortem timeline. also, any customer-facing ETA?

maria: mitigation started 6312345690. new pods healthy at 6312345718, backlog draining. still seeing occasional 502s while kv-cache warms.

alex: confirmed: queue length down to ~14k. error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% after route toggle + scale.

kevin: DB metrics: no significant write queue, redis hitrate dropped then rebounded — looks like cold cache pressure, not db lock.

support-bot: customer impact update: cust-ark saw ~8 minutes of failed embedding requests between 6312345665-6312346150, cust-hastings ~5 minutes. raising severity to P2 for post-incident follow-up.

alex: handing off primary ownership to @maria — i've got another high-priority pager inbound. Maria, can you own the bridge and biz comms?

maria: taking it. confirming ownership handoff in PD. i'll keep 1m status pings here until stable.

sre-oncall: noted. please include: exact mitigation steps, config diff (`minReplicas` bump, route toggled), timestamps, and impacted customers for the incident record.

maria: copy. snippet of commands i ran:
```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa embeddings-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/embeddings-svc
# toggled route
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane/redwood/routes/embeddings -d '{"route":"embeddings-approx-fast","force":true}'
```

maria: current status 6312345745 — error rate stable ~1.1%, queue ~9k and draining. leaving page open until fully below 500 and no customer errors for 5m.

alex: thanks — appreciate the handoff. i'll update the incident channel when i'm back. :thumbsup:

support-bot: created internal incident ticket INC-2026-314 and linked customer threads.

maria: noted. once we close, i'll write a short blameless postmortem with remediation: autoscaler sensitivity, warm pool suggestion, and a routing fallback playbook.

sre-oncall: thanks team. assigning follow-ups: autoscaler tuning -> eng-runtime, warm-pool proposal -> eng-platform, customer comms -> support.

maria: will post final closure here when below thresholds.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert P12345 status: acknowledged -> reassigned -> acknowledged by maria.
